argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: High, with repeated formalization of each premise across thinkers

argumentative_quality.logical_relevance: High; all components serve the central thesis of redefining the subject

distinctions_drawn: word of the world/word of life

summary_of_core_decisions: The text systematically dismantles the modern subject as originator of meaning and replaces it with a witness constituted by a higher other, using Marion's saturated phenomenon, Ricoeur's call/response, and Henry's word of life to show that finite cognitive conditions are not obstacles but receptive vessels for infinite donation.

thesis_commitment.hedging_density_in_final_paragraph: Low; final conclusion is assertive and unqualified
